text:
leah: Heads-up - Partner CPX submitted March invoice INV-CPX-202603-7711 and AWS flagged it for 'price band mismatch'. Payout paused. Anyone on this flow?
tom-fin: can you paste the invoice line?
leah: line: rdw-channel-prem | qty 350 | price $0.015. Our expected mapping (commitment) is rdw-channel-prem-v1 and price $0.018 for <500 seats.
billing-bot: Marketplace alert at 2026-03-08T09:12Z: PRICE_BANDING_CONFLICT. Hold placed.
akshay: hmm partner OSS reported they ran a pricing experiment in Feb with a temporary promotional band. Did partner notify us?
partner-am: We sent an ops CSV on 2026-02-26 titled "promo-band-apac.csv" - thought it was informational. We didn't expect it to change billed SKU. I'll attach the CSV.
leah: please attach and also include the partner PO and any signed amendment.
partner-am: attaching: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/partner-reports/CPX-promo-band-feb.csv

leah: quick excerpt from CSV:
```
sku, band_min, band_max, unit_price, note
rdw-channel-prem, 1, 499, 0.015, feb promo
rdw-channel-prem, 500, 9999, 0.013, standard
```

tom-fin: So they billed at promo price but we never approved an amendment to the commitment. That means contract price vs billed price mismatch. We can't reflexively credit unless legal/partner-ops sign off.
akshay: Operationally though, marketplace hold will delay payout and could trigger partner escalation. Suggest provisional 'tolerance' credit for up to $1,200 to avoid collections while partner submits corrected invoice or a signed pricing addendum. Finance sign?
tom-fin: Approve provisional tolerance credit up to $1,200 provided partner sends corrected invoice or signed amendment by EOD. If partner refuses, we keep the credit and offset next month.
partner-am: Understood. I'll escalate to partner billing and ask them to either (a) reissue invoice with standard sku rdw-channel-prem-v1 at $0.018 for 350 qty or (b) provide signed addendum for promo pricing.
leah: Noted. Please confirm when marketplace clears the hold. Also tag legal if addendum is provided.
billing-bot: Hold state updated: PENDING_PARTNER_ACTION. Notifications sent to ar@redwood and partner-ops@redwood.

leah: putting milestone for month-end close - if no correction by 2026-03-10 COB we will apply standard contract rates and generate debit memo.
akshay: adding note for month-end reconciliation.

partner-am: Partner replied - they will issue corrected invoice by EOD. Tagging here once received. :thumbsup:

leah: thanks, closing loop when marketplace releases payout.
